caption: The video depicts a woman on a gray yoga mat in a room with a plain wall, wooden floor, and tall mirror. She lies in a single-leg bridge, hips lifted, one knee bent and foot planted, one arm stretched flat along the mat and the other bent with its hand resting near her hip. Her head is turned to the side, and her other leg extends diagonally upward toward the upper left. The mirror reflects the same pose, showing the lifted hips, planted foot, and raised leg. For most of the excerpt, the body position is held steadily, with the raised leg straight and the supporting foot and torso fixed. Near the end, the raised leg changes position as the knee bends and the thigh rotates more upright, drawing the foot closer to vertical above the hip. The reflected image tracks this movement, showing the raised leg shift from extended to bent while the rest of the pose stays stable. The camera remains fixed, so the visible change comes from the woman's leg rather than view motion.
